_comment: Edge functions deployed with NO source in this repo. They cannot be read, reviewed, fixed or redeployed — only invoked or deleted. The list may only SHRINK: a new orphan fails the build. Each entry needs a reason and a way out. Regenerate with: node scripts/check-deployed-functions.mjs --write-baseline

generate-vr-world.reason: The VR World feature was removed (World Labs retires the Marble API on 2027-01-08). Retired in place to a 410 stub that holds no secret; nothing invokes it.
generate-vr-world.wayOut: Supabase dashboard, Edge Functions, generate-vr-world, Delete (or: supabase functions delete generate-vr-world --project-ref "$PROJECT_REF"). Then remove this entry.
